raw_text: Mr. FOOT. I now repeat the motion to adjourn.
The motion was agreed to ; and the Senate adjourned.

HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES. Monday, December 4, 1865. This being the day prescribed by the Consti- tution for the meeting of Congress, the mem- bers of the House of Representatives assembled in their Hall, aud at twelve o'clock, m., were called to order by Hon. Edward McPherson, Clerk' of the last House of Representatives. OllGANIZATION OF THE HOUSE.

The CLERK said: The hour having arrived for the meeting of the Thii'ty-Ninth Congress, the Clerk of the last House of Representatives will proceed, as required by law, to read by States the roll of members-elect. Gentlemen are requested to respond as their names are called.
The roll was then called, and the following members answered to their names :
